system.description: If the total number of Breaches the Engines system has suffered is equal to or greater than half the Scale of the ship, then the System has been significantly Damaged. This increases the Difficulty of all Tasks that involve or are assisted by the ship’s Engines by +2 until repaired. Further, the ship loses 1 Power at the end of every Round until this is repaired. The Difficulty to repair this is 3.
